class.name: IfcDocumentInformation
class.brief_description: IfcDocumentInformation captures "metadata" of an external document. The actual content of the document is not defined in IFC; instead, it can be found following the reference given to IfcDocumentReference . HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x.

members.member: Identifier that uniquely identifies a document.
File name or document name assigned by owner.
Description of document and its content.
Information about the person and/or organization acknowledged as the 'owner' of this document. In some contexts, the document owner determines who has access to or editing right to the document.
The persons and/or organizations who have created this document or contributed to it.
Date and time stamp when the document was originally created. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDateTime , the date time string according to ISO8601.
Date and time stamp when this document version was created. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDateTime , the date time string according to ISO8601.
Describes the electronic format of the document being referenced, providing the file extension and the manner in which the content is provided.
Date when the document becomes valid. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDate , the date string according to ISO8601.
Date until which the document remains valid. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDate , the date string according to ISO8601.
The level of confidentiality of the document.
The current status of the document. Examples of status values that might be used for a document information status include: - DRAFT - FINAL DRAFT - FINAL - REVISION
Resource identifier or locator, provided as URI, URN or URL, of the document information for online references. IFC2x4 CHANGE New attribute added at end of attribute list.
